Jwt.//Authority: This host's own OpenID Connect provider (NovaCore.Identity.OpenIddict). Run the https profile.

Database.//: true = apply all module migrations on boot (needs SQL Server reachable).

Seed.//: Set SeedOnStartup true + AdminPassword (user-secrets) to seed roles/permissions/admin/clients on boot.

Clients.//: The Scalar UI (public client, Authorization Code + PKCE). Its redirect URI is the Scalar page itself.

Seq.//: Point at a local Seq (e.g. http://localhost:5341) to get structured logs in a UI.
